errors.evidence: The horizontal axis scale shows only numerical counts (0, 10, 20, 30, 40). The percentage values are part of the data labels attached to the bars, not part of the axis itself.

errors.text_span: Стойностите на хоризонталната ос са етикетирани с числа и проценти, показващи относителния дял на всяка категория.
errors.evidence: The labels on the horizontal axis are single numbers (0, 10, 20, 30, 40). The labels containing both numbers and percentages are data labels at the end of each bar, not labels on the axis.
The actual label on the chart is 'RegiX среда за междурегистров обмен'. The word 'междууредов' is a transcription error for 'междурегистров'.
